visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of an orange-and-white cat looking curiously into a cream-colored mug filled with water, held by a human hand in a brightly lit indoor setting. (2) The scene shifts through a montage of different cats—a white cat with grey patches, a tortoiseshell cat, and an orange tabby—resting in various domestic locations like wooden floors, weighing scales, and sofas. (3) Close-up shots depict a cat licking wet food from a small ceramic plate, followed by another cat drinking from a white automated water fountain with flowing water. (4) A human hand is shown placing several mugs of water in different locations around the house, including near a cat’s plush bed and on a coffee table. (5) Comparative clips show a cat attempting to drink from a tall, narrow glass where its whiskers hit the rim, contrasted with a cat drinking comfortably from a wide, shallow white bowl. (6) The final phase shows a human hand feeding cat puree from a white-and-orange sachet to different cats, who lick the paste with high focus.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, energetic female voice opens with a greeting and a rhetorical question about cat behavior. Bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM plays in the background. (2) Narrative continues explaining the desert origin of cats; speech rate is brisk and enunciated. BGM remains constant at a lower volume relative to the voice. (3) A soft 'ding' SFX marks the transition into a list of tips. Faint lapping sounds and cat eating noises are blended into the mix occasionally. (4) The narrator provides instructional advice with a warm, encouraging tone. Music continues with its upbeat major-key melody. (5) Transition to a product endorsement; the voice remains enthusiastic but adds a persuasive inflection. Minor plastic rustling sounds are audible. (6) The video ends with a branded sign-off and a final upbeat musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate cat owners on the biological reasons why cats tend to drink very little water and provides three specific tips to encourage hydration. It concludes by promoting a branded cat puree product as a supplementary way to increase water intake.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly mentions the product name '好味貓肉泥條' and demonstrates its use to increase a cat's water intake.
